parameters.name: DateType
parameters.description: Time filter type, supporting filtering by the last 7 days, the last 30 days, the last half year, or custom time periods.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mssp get-attacked-asset-deal --date-type month --start-date 1732268720000 --end-date 1732268720000 --susp-event-source '暂时无需传参，有问题请联系管理员' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mssp GetAttackedAssetDeal --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate 1732268720000 --SuspEventSource '暂时无需传参，有问题请联系管理员' --DateType month --EndDate 1732268720000
